max_daemons.description: Maximum number of simultaneous POP3 daemon processes.

max_connections_per_ip.description: Maximum number of connections allowed per single IP address.

pop3_port.description: TCP port for standard POP3 (non-SSL) connections.

pop3s_port.description: TCP port for POP3 over SSL (POP3S).

ssl_cert_path.description: Path to the SSL certificate (PEM format) for POP3S.

starttls.description: Enable or disable STARTTLS support on the standard POP3 port.

tls_chain_path.description: Path to TLS certificate chain (intermediate CA). Optional.

allow_plaintext_auth.description: Allow plaintext authentication over non-SSL connections. Enable only if TLS is enforced elsewhere.

items.description: Authentication modules. Common values: 'authpam' for system users, 'authdaemon' for Courier’s internal auth.

auth_modules.description: List of authentication modules to load (in order of precedence).

items.description: Backup authentication modules. Usually same as auth_modules.

auth_modules_orig.description: Fallback authentication modules (used when modules fail).

debug_log.description: Enable verbose debug logging (for troubleshooting only).

log_path.description: Path to POP3 log file (if empty, uses syslog).

log_days.description: Number of days to retain log files (when log_path is set).

pop3_banner.description: Greeting banner shown to clients on connect.

pop3_idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before server disconnects the client.

max_message_size.description: Maximum message size in bytes (0 = unlimited).

lock_method.description: Locking method for mailbox access. 'fcntl' is recommended.

maildir_path.description: Base directory for mailboxes. Default uses Maildir format under each user’s home.

quota_dir.description: Directory for quota metadata files (used only if quota is enabled).

pipelining_enabled.description: Enable or disable POP3 command pipelining for improved performance.

capa_enabled.description: Enable CAPA command to report server capabilities.

uidl_utf8.description: Use UTF-8 in UIDL responses (RFC 6856 compliant).

case_insensitive_login.description: Treat usernames case-insensitively (helpful for legacy clients).

autologout_enabled.description: Automatically log out users after idle timeout.

proxy_enabled.description: Enable proxy mode (forward authentication to another Courier server).

proxy_host.description: Hostname or IP of the target proxy server (when proxy_enabled).

proxy_port.description: Port of the target proxy server.

bind_address.description: Specific IP address to bind to (empty = all interfaces).

tcpwrap_config.description: Service name for TCP Wrappers lookup (usually 'pop3').

smtputf8_enabled.description: Enable SMTPUTF8 extension (for non-ASCII email addresses).

burl_enabled.description: Enable BURL extension (for large attachments via URL).

auth_sasl.description: Enable full SASL support via Cyrus SASL library.

cram_md5_enabled.description: Enable CRAM-MD5 authentication mechanism (when SASL disabled).

auth_anonymous.description: Enable ANONYMOUS login (for testing only; NOT for production).

tls_session_cache_enabled.description: Enable TLS session caching for faster reconnections.

tls_cache_size.description: Maximum number of cached TLS sessions.

tls_cache_timeout.description: TLS session cache timeout in seconds.

tls_cipher_list.description: Cipher list for TLS (OpenSSL format, secure defaults).

ocsp_stapling_enabled.description: Enable OCSP stapling for real-time certificate validation.

proxy_verify_enabled.description: Verify certificates of proxied servers (for security).

proxy_dns_srv.description: Use DNS SRV records for proxy target resolution.

lmtp_enabled.description: Enable LMTP server (for local mail delivery to POP3 users).

lmtp_socket.description: UNIX socket path for LMTP (used if enabled).

pop3_unix_socket_enabled.description: Enable POP3 over UNIX socket (for local clients only).

pop3_unix_socket.description: Path to POP3 UNIX socket (used if enabled).

proxy_auth_enabled.description: Enable proxy authentication socket (for multi-tier auth).

proxy_auth_socket.description: Path to proxy auth socket (used if enabled).
